answer: Locks are recorded in pulse, expire in echo, and lotus lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 16 aliases therefore needs 196 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3483 identities would post 3511 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
